L8·N7558unmasked layer
Fires on the pronoun/complement immediately following verbs of asking, requesting, or agreeing (e.g. "ask **me**", "sends **me**", "agrees **to**", "requested **to**", "demands for … **help**"), i.e., the object or infinitival "to" of a request/agreement predicate; it is suppressed on pronouns after ordinary prepositions like "with us", "for you", "joining me".
